name: Birthday balloons
summary: Bunch of five shiny mixed-colour balloons tied together with curly ribbons; for birthday and party scenes. Anim bob.

params.name: y
params.note: y of the tied knot; the balloons rise about 500 px above it

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at the default the bunch is about 700 px wide

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = the bunch rises and falls gently, each balloon out of step
